scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace=@tuvitrina/contracts && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@tuvitrina/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@tuvitrina/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@tuvitrina/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@tuvitrina/api && npm run build --workspace=@tuvitrina/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run start --workspace=@tuvitrina/api" "npm run start --workspace=@tuvitrina/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@tuvitrina/contracts && npm run lint --workspace=@tuvitrina/api && npm run lint --workspace=@tuvitrina/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@tuvitrina/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@tuvitrina/api
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:generate --workspace=@tuvitrina/api && npm run codegen:openapi --workspace=@tuvitrina/contracts
